description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §5.2 + §5.3 member key derivation: from (master_password, user_id) derive the 16-byte salt, run Argon2id with the §4.2 parameters to a 64-byte seed_material, and split it into the X25519 private-key seed [0:32] and the auth_verification_token [32:64]. The input fully determines the output (Argon2id is deterministic), but the expected bytes come from a NAMED EXTERNAL AUTHORITY (an offline Argon2id run), NOT from Cephios server code — the derivation is client-side per §5.3 and there is no server-side Argon2id (the auth-no-argon2 discipline; KC).
notes: Expected bytes pinned from a NAMED EXTERNAL AUTHORITY — an offline Argon2id run (argon2-cffi 25.1.0 / cryptography 48.0.0) with the §4.2 parameters — per the CS §17.4 bootstrap (the Cephios cloud has no server-side Argon2id; auth-no-argon2 / KC). seed_material_hex = x25519_private_key_seed_hex || auth_verification_token_hex (64 bytes); the X25519 public key is derived from the seed per RFC 7748; auth_verification_token_sha256_hex = SHA-256(auth_verification_token) is the stored credential per CS §5.4 step 6. This is a BOOTSTRAP reference, NOT Go-oracle-verified — Group 12 (cephios-core, Python) MUST reproduce these bytes and Group 13 (@cephios/core) cross-verifies, per the §17.4 dual-source steady-state discipline. master_password and user_id are documented test values (no live secret).
